hard_gates: Every positive SapBalance delta has one exact, typed, owner-bound issuance or recipient-claim cause.
Every negative SapBalance delta has one exact, typed, owner-bound debit / transfer / demurrage / staking / Hearth cause.
A single cause ActionHash cannot justify two balance successors.
One monetary balance successor expresses one economic cause; demurrage and principal movement are separate predecessor-linked transitions.
Metadata-only updates preserve the monetary balance and historical cause pointer.
A nonzero SapBalance cannot be created through raw credit_sap.
Hearth unavailable or malformed membership result is never treated as authorization for value movement.
Hearth withdrawal cannot debit pool unless a member claim / credit is durably committed or explicitly Pending.
All integer arithmetic is checked before mutation.
Same-predecessor competing owner-authored successors freeze spendability; no winner is selected by DHT link order.
